tasks.title: Incorrect query result caused by comparing decimal and float type value

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: DECIMAL默认0位小数下数据为0，WHERE与投影比较有清晰不一致判据；9.0修复不覆盖8.0。

test_spec.steps: 执行cmain的WHERE c0<=-0.8和投影IS TRUE对照。
test_spec.oracle: 0<=-0.8应为假，WHERE不得返回0行值；比较投影为0及筛选空集。
test_spec.target_applicability: 目标版支持DECIMAL比较；本次仅补审32/33/34，35保留原候选。

comments.author: Jon Stephens
comments.text:
Documented fix as follows in the MySQL 9.0.0 changelog:

    In some cases, DECIMAL 0 was treated as less than a FLOAT value
    between 0 and -1.

Closed.

comments.author: Jean-François Gagné
comments.text:
Related: Bug#117093.

I confirm this is fixed in 9.2.0, but it is not fixed in 8.4.4 and 8.0.41.  Can we expect a fix in 8.0 and 8.4 ?

sql="select version();
       drop table IF EXISTS t0;
       CREATE TABLE t0(c0 DECIMAL);
       REPLACE INTO t0(c0) VALUES(0.1);
       SELECT count(*) FROM t0 WHERE t0.c0 <= - 0.8;"

./use test -N <<< "$sql"
9.2.0
0

./use test -N <<< "$sql"
8.4.4
1

./use test -N <<< "$sql"
8.0.41
1
